spec.disposition: FAITHFUL (interval trigger; first-fire phase is a FLAG)
spec.assertion: skill1-slot damage events recur 40..500 times over 180s, and the CDR counterfactual proves the cadence is a live timer. Nearest-wrong {kind:'passive'} / a one-shot battleStart yields 1 volley; the t=0-vs-t=4s phase is NOT pinned (blind convention).

Volley existence is asserted by bounds only; the flavor is proved INDIRECTLY and much more strongly by the S2-b test (ungating the 85.17% Sequential buff must raise damage, which is only possible if these spears carry flavor:'sequential'). Riders take noRange:true and crit at her rate, no core (text says no core here).

spec.disposition: FAITHFUL on scope / MEASUREMENT-GATED on stacking
spec.assertion: Proves it is a BOSS debuff (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) and never a self buff: deleting it drops BOTH her damage and teamSum. Nearest-wrong (self/allies target) leaves teammates byte-identical. The stack ceiling is deliberately NOT asserted — kit states no cap (it.skip + recipe).

spec.kitLine: when using Burst Skill -> all enemies
spec.assertion: Order-based: a burst-cast application is logged before the first fullBurstStart, so countBeforeFirstFb(faithful) > countBeforeFirstFb(re-keyed-to-fullBurstEnter). The nearest-wrong also over-fires on helm's Full Bursts in any 2xB3 comp.

spec.disposition: FIX — needs selfStatus + requiresSelfStatus (no 'within 10s of own cast' gate otherwise)
spec.assertion: Opening every gate on the rider block must multiply its proc count by >1.8x (whole fight vs <=~50s of windows). Non-vacuity: the faithful run must ALSO have procs (>=20), so both the active and inactive case are exercised.

Recurrence: procs >= 20 (a once-per-window model gives ~4) and procs <= shots/2 + 12 (counts ROUNDS, not frames). Core-ness: setting core:false lowers her damage while leaving teammates byte-identical (coreAttackMultiplier 200 makes this unmissable).

Deleting the buff must cost at least 3 spear volleys (4s->2s over a 10s window is +2.5 fires per burst, 3+ bursts in 180s) and lower her total. Nearest-wrong is omitting the line entirely (a very easy miss) or encoding it as a burst-cooldown reduction, which moves no volleys.

spec.kitLine: FB enter while NOT in state -> Seq +85.17%
spec.disposition: FIX — ownBurstGate:'notCast' stands in for the missing negated self-status gate
spec.assertion: In base (2xB3) #seq + #core === #fullBurstStart exactly; in solo (sole B3, always in state) #seq === 0. Nearest-wrong (no gate) doubles the sum; both-on-burstCast drops it below fbs. Ungating it must RAISE damage, proving the buff is not inert, and must leave teammates byte-identical (self scope).

spec.kitLine: FB enter while IN state -> Core +24.64%
spec.assertion: solo: #core === #fullBurstStart exactly (she bursts every rotation, so the state is always open at FB entry). Deleting the buff lowers her damage and nothing else — proves it is live (she has core damage from MG core hits plus the core rider) and self-scoped.

Removing it reduces total shots fired (300-round belt, 171-frame reload: a mid-belt refill deletes reload downtime). Flagged in-file as the most cadence-sensitive assertion (ties if every burst lands on a full belt).

spec.disposition: GAP (no schema primitive for MG spin-up)
spec.assertion: it.skip with a measurement recipe, PLUS an active anti-fudge pin: no self fireRatePct/attackSpeedPct buffApply with value exactly 100. A literal 1:1 transcription doubles her cadence for 10s; a measured haircut proxy still passes.

Self-granted application count === fullBurstStart count (+1 horizon slack) and the two stats agree; value < 1000 proves atkPct kept its RAW percentage rather than being emitted flat-resolved as casterAtkPct (the documented harness trap).

burst-srcSlot damage instances number <= her cast count (one per cast) and every one has fbMajorApplied falsy — the burst cast resolves before the FB window opens, so the +50% FB major must not apply. Nearest-wrong (FB-major credited) is the classic burst over-credit.

(1) controlComp('marian-queen', true) = liter/crown/marian-queen/helm — kept BECAUSE the fixed helm slot is a second Burst III, the only way a Full Burst can be completed on a rotation she did not burst, which is what makes the S2-b 'not in state' branch reachable; used for the (#sequential + #core) === #fullBurstStart invariant. (2) controlComp('marian-queen', false) = liter/crown/marian-queen — she is the SOLE B3, so she casts every rotation and is therefore always in Penetrant Wish at FB entry: the branch split becomes deterministic (#core === #fbStarts, #sequential === 0) and her own burst count === #fbStarts. All eight counterfactuals run on (2) for that determinism. Both fixtures include B1+B2 so bursts actually cast. No seed (deterministic).
